finding.title: Hardcoded default replacement directories for the no-dependencies path
finding.message: When `dependencies` is None, the framework/Core and typesetting replacements are forced to guessed paths under `drivers/cogent/build/`. The old code used the driver's own go.mod replacements in that case. If those directories are missing or are not the sources the driver really uses, `go mod download all`/`go mod verify` fails, or the inventory is built against the wrong sources. Nothing in the diff checks that the paths exist.
finding.suggestion: Require explicit `dependencies` or check that the default directories exist and contain a go.mod, failing with a clear error otherwise. Alternatively keep the driver's existing replace directives and only make them absolute.
finding.evidence: owned = dependencies if dependencies is not None else {name: root / "drivers/cogent/build" / name for name in ("upstream", "typesetting")}

discarded.reason: refuted by anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5: The default paths are a deliberate choice, because go.mod is now copied to a temp dir where its relative replace directives would break. They use the same `upstream` and `typesetting` names as the `dependencies` mapping. If the directories are missing, `go mod download all` or `go mod verify` fails, or the new `dependency source unavailable` ValueError is raised, so the build fails closed instead of producing a wrong inventory. The claim of silently wrong sources rests on speculation the diff does not support.
